value.rationale: Sharp all-positive-c logarithmic-codimension law for the geometrically natural diameter preservation of a regular simplex under random near-full-dimensional projection. Nontrivial growing-dimensional nearest-pair dependence needs a strict overlap Chernoff exponent, not routine single-edge concentration or arbitrary parameters. The explicit root s−1−log s=4/c distinguishes near-preserved diameters and concentration regimes.
